title: CEG Independent Replay Submission
description: Non-normative template for reporting independent replay results. Does not define protocol semantics.

implementation_name.description: Name of the implementation under test

implementation_version.description: Version or commit of the implementation

platform.description: Operating system and architecture (e.g. Linux x86_64)

bundle_version.description: Conformance bundle version, tag, or commit SHA

bundle_manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 of the bundle's manifest.json, if computed

divergences.description: Detailed divergence records (optional if count is zero)

layer.description: Which stage or artifact layer differed

expected.description: Expected value or hash (truncated if sensitive)

actual.description: Actual value or hash (truncated if sensitive)

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the replay run

notes.description: Optional free-form notes from the reviewer
